items.title: Wanaka Studio
items.source_text: Wanaka Studio Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity. Artificial Intelligence Games No-Code

items.title: Glasshand
items.source_text: Glasshand Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it. Productivity Artificial Intelligence Apple

items.title: Floot Payments
items.source_text: Floot Payments Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude Floot apps can now take real money. Ask your AI in ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for "a $9/month plan", "a checkout for this course" or "shipping labels for my orders", and Floot sets it up: subscriptions with a billing page, one-time payments, tickets and deposits, coupons and refunds, plus shipping with live rates, labels and tracking. Runs on Stripe, no API keys or webhooks. Test free in preview, go live when you publish. Payments Artificial Intelligence Vibe coding

items.title: Prelulu
items.source_text: Prelulu Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story Immersive stories with AI characters you can text or video roleplay with. It's our first time bringing real-time avatar technology to consumer scale. You can create your own characters with live avatar capability. Artificial Intelligence Games Entertainment

items.title: Render Sandboxes
items.source_text: Render Sandboxes A computer for every agent Render Sandboxes give every agent its own isolated Linux computer. Sandboxes starts in under a second and can run any agent or harness, like Claude Code or Codex. Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop. It wakes with files and memory intact. And you can reliably run thousands at once - all on the same platform as the rest of your app. Developer Tools Artificial Intelligence SDK
